completeness.why: getNextDate passes its raw skipWeekend/weekendSolve to applyWeekendRule and keeps only its own noSkipWeekend option (a variation only that site has, allowed to stay local); getUpcomingDates passes its raw config fields with no local condition. Both createScheduleList sites call applyWeekendRule but keep their own `dateConditions.value.skipWeekend ? dayFromDate(applyWeekendRule(...)) : nextBaseDate` ternary, so the enable decision is still made at the site (twice), which is the partial case.

interface.why: applyWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) takes exactly the real variation (enable flag and mode) and leaves each caller to map its own field name (weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode), keeping noSkipWeekend at its only site; the `solveMode as 'after' | 'before'` cast that hides an undefined mode is a small wart.

disguised_duplication.where: The leftover skipWeekend ternaries in budget/schedule-template.ts repeat the enable check that applyWeekendRule now makes, but plainly, not disguised.
